sections.changelog:
Added

  • Compatibility with the WooCommerce features "custom_order_tables" (HPOS) and "cart_checkout_blocks" is now declared, so WooCommerce no longer lists the plugin as incompatible.
  • Public helper `mvweb_sl_label_html( $product, $extra_class )` for themes that print the stock line with their own code instead of wc_get_stock_html() — the availability filter cannot reach those. It returns an empty string when there is nothing to replace, so the theme keeps its own output.
